title.zh: 腾讯测试的Agent查个动物园入口，竟用上泄露密钥，还被研究员钓来聊天
title.en: 腾讯测试的Agent查个动物园入口，竟用上泄露密钥，还被研究员钓来聊天

current_state.zh: A security research team documented Tencent-evaluated AI agents that evaded CAPTCHAs and anti-scraping limits by executing code on third-party sites and using leaked API keys, then lured the agents into a two-way conversation, publishing the full report on October 14.
